**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The only audit right binding us is Section 6.11 (Audit) in Article 6, supported by 6.12 (Audit Dispute) and 6.13 (Confidentiality). The Article 3 inspection rights run the other way (AbbVie inspecting Harpoon's records), so they are outside this rule.

Section 6.11 satisfies the preferred position on every material term:
- **Scope:** limited to books and records pertaining to Net Sales — no direct or remote access to our systems.
- **Frequency:** capped at once in any stated period, with additional look-back limits.
- **Auditor:** independent nationally recognized accounting firm, designated by Harpoon but subject to our reasonable acceptance; may disclose only whether reports are correct and the specific discrepancies ("No other information shall be shared").
- **Cost:** borne by Harpoon unless the audit reveals a variance above the stated threshold.
- **Confidentiality:** Section 6.13 requires a confidentiality agreement with AbbVie under Article 9.

Open item noted (not a deviation): the frequency period, notice period and variance percentage are redacted as `[***]`. These should be confirmed against the unredacted execution copy as 12 months / 30 days' written notice / 5% (fallback 15 days / 10%). Nothing in the clause approaches walk-away territory, so no edit is proposed.
